generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, reflecting on experience is something you practise throughout your studies and beyond. Every placement log, every project review and every reflective task draws on the same method you have built here. The ability to take an experience, work out what it taught you, and act differently is what turns time spent into genuine development. Wherever you are given work, judged against a standard, and told how to improve, the people who get better are the ones who treat each round as feeding the next.
